'''Josh Radke''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 84 from Terryville, Ct. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Other sourced notes ==

Red 84, Terryville, Connecticut. Wrote TheForce.Net Flashback Premiere interview with Chuck Kallenbach, bylined as Red 84.
